name: RESO Web API
tagline: OData standard for MLS property data interchange
description: Industry-standard OData-based Web API for MLS and real estate data interchange, defined by the Real Estate Standards Organization (RESO). Individual MLSs and data providers expose their own RESO-compliant endpoints rather than a single central API.

auth.details: Provider-specific OAuth2 or API key; each MLS/vendor issues credentials for their endpoint

use_cases: query active MLS listings by city or price
fetch property details by listing key
sync listing status changes from an MLS
export property media/photo URLs for a listing
